2026-10-03.patch_summary: This patch adds a new function, mem_cgroup_reclaim_for_batch(), which allows callers to reclaim memory from a memory cgroup in batches instead of one folio at a time. This is useful for callers that charge a batch of folios one at a time, such as readahead, and can trigger multiple reclaim passes when the memory cgroup limit is reached. The function retries reclaim only once if it fails, making it suitable for callers that are okay with charges failing. The patch also adds a new function to internal.h to provide a default implementation for non-MEMCG configurations.
